title: The evidence bound leaves a KL gap
hook: Two stated cases: explore the defining evidence-bound identity.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the defining evidence-bound identity affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines ELBO, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the defining evidence-bound identity in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy model has log evidence -5 and KL gap 2. From ELBO=log evidence-KL, what bound value results?
